metadata.title: Finiteness of closed arithmetic hyperbolic surface bundles
metadata.abstract: For each $g\ge 2$, we show that there are finitely many cyclic commensurability classes of closed, fibered arithmetic hyperbolic $3$-manifolds with genus $g$ fiber. More generally, we show that there are only finitely many conjugacy classes of admissible surface subgroups of PSL$_2(\mathbb{C})$ whose image is contained in the fundamental group of some arithmetic hyperbolic $3$-manifold. We also give an effectively computable upper bound with effective asymptotic rate on both finiteness statements. This affirms a conjecture of Bowditch, Maclachlan, and Reid.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 算术双曲曲面丛的有限性
analysis.workSummary: 对固定纤维亏格 g≥2，证明闭纤维化算术双曲三流形只有有限个循环可公度类，并给出可有效计算的上界及渐近速率。
analysis.breakthrough: 验证 Bowditch–Maclachlan–Reid 的相关猜想并强化为有效有限性。
analysis.limitations: 计数对象是循环可公度类，不能写成该亏格下流形本身只有有限多个。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 5.6 仅用于项目末期检查排印错误与符号一致性，并明确未作其他用途。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 5.6 仅用于项目末期检查排印错误与符号一致性，并明确未作其他用途。
